decision: 5 second time penalty (2 penalty points awarded, 6 points for the 12 month period)
event_name: Date 16 September 2018 Time 22:36 2018 SINGAPORE GRAND PRIX 13 - 16 September 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 35 forced car 28 off the track in turn 14.
offence: Breach of Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations read with Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2b of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that approaching turn 14 car No. 28 was passing car No. 35. Car No. 35 forced car No. 28 off the track so much so that car No. 28 had to come to a near stop to avoid a collision.
rules_referenced: Article 27.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations read with Appendix L Chapter IV Article 2b of the FIA International Sporting Code
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Doc 36 2018 Singapore Grand Prix Offence Car 35 Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
